quotes.title: K2-239
quotes.card: K2-239 is a small red dwarf star in the constellation Sextans, about 32 parsecs away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: Observed by the Kepler Space Telescope during Campaign 14 of its K2 "Second Light" mission, it was found to have three hot, likely rocky Earth-sized planets in orbit around it.
